name: Arcs
description: A sci-fi game of bitter ambition for 2–4 players, with or without the Leaders & Lore setup. Win by reaching the Power threshold for your player count.

roundEnd.label: Who took the initiative this round?

setupSteps.label: Play with Leaders & Lore
setupSteps.description: Draft a Leader and a Lore card each. Your Leader replaces the core starting pieces and resources.

setupSteps.label: Initiative
setupSteps.description: Choose which player starts with the initiative marker. Randomise it for a fair opening.

setupSteps.label: Set up the map
setupSteps.description: Shuffle the setup cards for your player count and draw one. Cover the out-of-play clusters it shows (2 clusters for 2–3 players, 1 for 4).

setupSteps.label: Place starting pieces
setupSteps.description: Going clockwise from the initiative player, place each player's starting ships, city, and starport on their A / B / C systems, and take the 2 starting resources shown.

setupSteps.label: Lay out Leaders & Lore
setupSteps.description: Lay out a face-up row of Leaders and a face-up row of Lore, each with one more card than the number of players. Starting to the right of the initiative player and going counter-clockwise, take turns drafting one Leader or one Lore at a time until everyone has exactly one of each.

setupSteps.label: Leader
setupSteps.description: Each player records the Leader they drafted. This sets your name graphic and your portrait on the score track.

setupSteps.label: Set up your Leader
setupSteps.description: Place your starting pieces in the A / B / C boxes on your Leader card and take the 2 resources it shows, in the two leftmost slots. Then, in turn order, resolve any extra setup steps your Leader lists.

setupSteps.label: Court & action cards
setupSteps.description: Shuffle the Court deck and deal a face-up row of 3 cards (2 players) or 4 cards (3–4 players). Shuffle the action deck — values 2–6, adding the 1s and 7s for 4 players — and deal each player a hand of 6.
